body.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal M_n\), the estimator \(\widehat z\) has a joint root-\(n\) asymptotic linear expansion driven by weighted contiguous-block sums of \(\phi_t\), including the covariance between mean and second-moment estimation; the block/HAC estimator \(\widehat V\) is uniformly consistent for the resulting nonsingular covariance \(V(P)\).
body.justification: Same-panel inference must propagate pre-weight estimation and covariance estimation jointly; fixed-weight post error variance is not the estimator variance.
body.gap: Fry2024MomentsSC supplies fixed-donor mixing limits, while CattaneoFengTitiunik2021PredictionIntervals separates fitted-weight and future-outcome errors; the required joint block-mean and residual-covariance expansion for population MSE is not given there.
body.consumer: The expansion supports feasible uncertainty quantification without sample splitting or target post-treatment counterfactuals.
